amendment: V2.1 only replaces non-deterministic Python object-memory hashing in state_fingerprint with canonical UTF-8 material IDs and little-endian float64 arrays. No data, feature, split, seed, model, acquisition, calibration, endpoint, or inferential setting changed. The initial dry-run showed identical candidate IDs, predictions, uncertainties, and queried-ID hashes across repeats; only the diagnostic fingerprint differed.
primary_boundary: The old 3216-record V5 confirmation is read-only; V2 has a distinct data snapshot, namespace, seeds, and output directories.

dry_run.repeatability_canary: Repeat all four condition-policy trajectories for seed 2026092600 under distinct artifact IDs.

features.implementation: Pymatgen Composition; sorted dataset-wide element fractions plus total atoms and distinct-element count; float64; fill missing values with zero; reject non-finite values; no scaling or feature selection.

surrogate.raw_uncertainty: population standard deviation (ddof=0) over tree predictions
surrogate.oob: per-tree predictions only for rows excluded from that tree bootstrap sample; minimum 3 OOB trees for residual calibration

local_calibration.crossfit: 5 folds ordered by SHA-256 of stable material ID; fold seeds derive from campaign seed and stage
local_calibration.global_scale: median valid OOB absolute residual ratio / 0.67448975

campaign.initial_count: max(30, round(0.01 * task_rows)), capped at source size
campaign.batches: four integer-balanced sequential batches summing exactly to query_budget
campaign.initial_source_sample: numpy.default_rng(seed), without replacement, sorted by row index

outcomes.primary_v2_metric: query-order trapezoidal integrated recall for target top 1%
outcomes.summary: paired seed distributions; mean, median, SD, range, positive fraction; no V2 p-values

leakage_controls: target labels are not passed to model fitting, calibration, or acquisition
diagnostic labels are used only for descriptive MACE after selection
candidate truth/tail labels are attached after acquisition ranking and batch selection
source, diagnostic, and target memberships are disjoint; chemical-system OOD groups are disjoint
retry_policy: Only retry a failed row with identical protocol, config, seed, and output identity; record each attempt. No silent exclusions.
beta_alpha_grid: not planned; do not run absent a prespecified ambiguity from the second-surrogate or tail analyses
